mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates applied to equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading exceeding 320 signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank hawkishness, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 320, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and CPIAUCSL signal a monetary tightening cycle with rising real rates, which depresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both FEDFUNDS rises by at least 0.25pp and CPIAUCSL rises by at least 0.5pp over the prior month, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market cooling regime, a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals weakening economic activity that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises by at least 0.2pp in the prior month during a labor market cooling regime, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts reading below 1500 thousand units signals weak consumer demand for housing, which correlates with broader economic slowdown and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST falls below 1500, or the Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by at least 1% from the prior month, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a supply-side shock that disrupts corporate production and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls by at least 0.5% from the prior month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
